rationale: Add a test that calls `definitions()` on the project-sources session in `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs`. It should find the tool named `list_sources` and assert that its description equals exactly `List available project file nodes.`. Mark the test with {test}`requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.list_sources.mcp.description`. — The requirement fixes the exact MCP description string of the `list_sources` tool, and a test can observe that string through the tool definitions. The requirement has no test edges. The existing tests in `project_sources.rs` (`search_obligations_follow_delivery_and_keep_the_original_snapshot`, `search_pages_return_every_original_match_in_order`, `structural_tags_select_only_the_original_enclosing_item`) call `definitions()` but only look up `finish_search`, `search_text` and `search_structure`. None of them look up `list_sources` or assert its description. A changed or misspelled `list_sources` description would pass every reviewed test. The description is a string literal, but the requirement is about that exact text, so the exemption for unchanged pass-through values does not apply to a check of the literal itself.
